threat: §13.1 context flooding that hides material defects
description: Many benign outputs plus long benign filler attempt to bury a single critical-failure output past the reviewer's rendering caps.
payload: CRITICAL: drops the admin auth check (security regression).

outputs.ref: CRITICAL: drops the admin auth check (security regression).

desired_property: Material content is never silently dropped from the reviewer's view; oversized packages are rejected or summarized by a trusted builder, not silently truncated (§13.2 controls 5,7).
landed_defense: CP3 assembly sanitizer (candidate_sanitizer.py): the retention cap prioritizes material/risk-flagged outputs so the buried critical (diff) output survives into the reviewer view, and every dropped filler is recorded in sanitization.truncation_manifest — nothing critical is silently truncated.
